His officiis adiungendum eft quartum illud

nec per ipfas, nec per nos terta eft neceffitas atque

page.notes: Several words are doubtful because of the scan quality and the show-through from the reverse side: "fancta", "sedibus", "illæ ipfæ duæ", "tempo-ris", "prooc-cafione", "nos terta", "quafi" and "dicrum" are marked [?].
